info.headline: Notify NYC - Silver Alert - Gladys Denros (QN)
info.description:
Silver Alert issued 10-22-2026 at 08:47 PM.
A Silver Alert has been issued for Gladys Denros, an 89-year-old White Female, last seen near New York Presbyterian Hospital in Queens on the morning of 10-22-2026. Gladys has Alzheimer's, may seem disoriented, and may be in need of medical attention.
Description: Grey/white hair. Last seen wearing a red burgundy jacket, orange sweater, brown slacks, brown shoes, walking with a cane, and possibly carrying a blue bag.
If you see Gladys, please call 1-800-577-8477 (TIPS) or 9-1-1.
A photo of Gladys is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sHL866
